opinion.text: No real news: duplicated price predictions [1,2], generic data/educational pages [3,4], a pullback recap [5], and a corporate treasury disclosure about USD cash and BTC (not BCH) misfiled here [6]. Verdict unchanged, treat as noise.

A 12% whale-driven drop amid broad risk-off [1,4] confirms ongoing fragility; a Grayscale Trust NAV overhaul [3] is a real but minor structural item. A community call [2] may bear on the contested fork but resolves nothing yet; [5,6] are routine/tangential.

A post-quantum testnet launching in September [1] is a real, minor dated technical catalyst (FC6); [6] just covers the same price move. Doesn't touch collapsing L1/Etherlink usage or the 3.5% issuance drag. [2][4][5] are unrelated filler; [3]'s 82-token liquidity list may or may not include XTZ.
